verdict.rationale: The evidence shows uv records exact project dependencies in a cross-platform `uv.lock` (uv-docs-17) and keeps the project environment in step with it (uv-docs-2). Community users report that `uv run` handles the venv and Python install automatically with no manual activation (uv-comm-10, uv-comm-6), and uv can install the pinned Python itself (uv-docs-6, uv-docs-50). However, no item explicitly documents a single command that bootstraps a fresh clone by installing everything the project declares, so the core of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit documented sync/install-from-lockfile command for fresh clones, coverage of installing all declared groups/extras, and hands-on corroboration of the fresh-clone bootstrap flow.
